body.statement: On the uniform \(M\)-slice with \(n\ge2M\), the Johnson harmonic degree spaces \(\mathcal H_{n,0},\ldots,\mathcal H_{n,M}\) form an orthogonal direct-sum decomposition of \(L^2(\Omega_{n,M})\).

source.locator: Theorem 4.1 and Lemma 4.3, pages 10 and 12 of arXiv:1406.0142v2
source.verbatim_statement: Theorem 4.1. Let n and k ≤ n/2 be integers, and put p = k/n. The set {χ_B : B ∈ B_{n,d} for some d ≤ k} is an orthogonal basis for the vector space of functions on the slice. Lemma 4.3. Let n, k be integers such that k ≤ n/2, and let M belong to the Bose–Mesner algebra of the (n, k) Johnson association scheme. The bases Y_{n,0}, …, Y_{n,k} span the eigenspaces of M.
